notes.title: Welcome!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Plane Deconstructors! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]We’re happy to see you’re eager to enter the world of [b]plane graveyard[/b] and explore the huge desert filled with wrecks.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3128610/Plane_Graveyard_Simulator/

Our game is in the early stages of development and we believe that together with you we’ll create a better game! 💪 That’s why we’ll release devlogs to showcase the mechanics and other cool features. We’d love to have your opinions on them and of course if you’re interested in any topic in particular make sure to let us know and we’ll do our best to cover it in the upcoming devlog! 👍

[previewyoutube=d8SaxqyI7xA;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Want to have an impact on the game? Jump on our Discord, get a special role and write a suggestion for the game! 👇[/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/5xX2cPE52p][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141938/fd77bdc9fdb53d2645680ae1cc59536d2d1789c2.png[/img][/url]

[h3]What’re the main goals in the game? 📝[/h3]
Your business runs dismantling airplane wrecks. That’s why you can anticipate lots of cutting, taking down and destruction! 💥 Use lifts to access hard-to-reach parts of the airplanes, find valuable elements and collect them all for the profit! 💰

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141938/3c73ebbb9151f474bd99912b0816fa83339a1fca.gif[/img]

Deliver components of the hull to the scrapyard for processing and earn money at the scrapyard.

Complete complex tasks such as recovering engines. Remember, engines are expensive equipment and hasty actions can result in damage and loss of money. ☹️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141938/ce8ee4b395326ac31c376afffd6283847143ee40.gif[/img]

Your office is like a second home. It’s vital to your operations because you can manage orders and discover new missions from there. Complete tasks within specified time and earn additional money!

Invest it to develop your business- buy new planes, hangars and become a real hegemon of the airplane graveyard industry! ✈️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141938/c88048aa2498523e0b15ab8291fd74da32be98ae.gif[/img]

We’re positive that together with you we can create a game that’s going to be satisfying and extremely fun to play. If you’d like to take an active part in the development process please add the Plane Graveyard Simulator to your Wishlist to get notified as soon as any news appears! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3128610/Plane_Graveyard_Simulator/

See you soon!
Plane Graveyard Simulator Team
